approved_direction_rule: Per reference day: (minimum available morning duration + minimum available evening return duration) / 2
approved_day_rule: Mean of the two day-level reference durations, approved explicitly on 2026-10-06
duration_rule: Exclude initial waiting only; retain in-vehicle time, connecting waits and coded walking
coverage_rule: No 24/24 filter; a direction without a usable duration remains missing
missing_day_rule: Do not substitute or impute a missing day; retain available day values separately, flag two-day reference as incomplete
local_rule: Zero for actual origin/station-departure coincidence backed by endpoint evidence; otherwise documented directional walking duration; unresolved local candidates are not classified as no connection
query_routing_rule: Retain existing earliest-arrival itinerary for each requested departure; take minima among these returned itineraries, not claim a globally minimum-duration search
retained_collection_bounds: Existing six vehicle legs, 480 minutes including wait and morning profile horizon retained, not a new analytical exclusion
actual_station_last_mile_caveat: Bus/train access nodes are not all verified lift departures. Node durations remain a proxy; no unverified last-mile minutes or geographic coincidence inferred.
